setting.en: Green branches by the road show the way to Marko's farm in Brda: this year he has opened his first osmica. For a few days he sells his own wine at home, with bread, pršut, cheese and hard-boiled eggs, at long wooden tables.
setting.de: Grüne Zweige an der Straße zeigen den Weg zu Markos Hof in Brda: Dieses Jahr hat er seine erste Osmica geöffnet. Ein paar Tage lang verkauft er zu Hause seinen eigenen Wein, dazu Brot, Pršut, Käse und hart gekochte Eier, an langen Holztischen.
setting.it: Le frasche verdi lungo la strada indicano la via per la fattoria di Marko nel Collio: quest'anno ha aperto la sua prima osmiza. Per qualche giorno vende in casa il suo vino, con pane, prosciutto crudo, formaggio e uova sode, a lunghi tavoli di legno.

role: Vinar Marko, the young winemaker from Brda, at his first osmica. Proud and a little nervous: pours his rebula and merlot, brings plates of pršut and cheese, says what costs what and that he is open until Sunday. Drops in an Italian word (allora). Says ti to {learner}.
